core_meaning.primary_meaning: Hanadi is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Indian”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Hanadi corresponds to the Arabic form هند (Arabic هِنْد (Hind)). Its core sense is lady, noble one. Hanadi is a feminine personal name built on the Arabic name هِنْد (Hind), the name of several documented early Islamic women. CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave هندي ('Indian', masculine) as the Arabic form and glossed the name 'gracious, merciful'; the correct base form is هند and the gloss has been replaced. Recorded at medium confidence because the relationship of the form hanadi to هند is a naming convention rather than a lexical derivation.

persian.name: هند
persian.long_meaning: Hanadi (هند) نامی برگرفته از زبان عربی است و معنای اصلی آن بانو، زن نجیب است. این نام در جوامع مسلمان به کار می‌رود و کاربرد آن بسته به بافت زبانی متفاوت است.
